Docket 1.3.114

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A docs site's section label is no longer read as a second brand name.* On a site at docs.<company>.com whose
  logo is followed by the word "Docs", the report said the brand name appeared two ways, the company's name and
  "Docs". The logo link names the section, so it no longer counts as a name. A logo that names a different
  company is still reported.
- *The typeface count no longer counts each weight of one font as a typeface.* A site that names every weight
  and width of a font in one word ("MyriadProCondBold"), or writes "Semi Bold" as two words, was told it used
  dozens of typefaces when it used a handful. Weights, widths and italics now count as the font they belong
  to, and icon fonts are not counted as typefaces. Two different fonts are still two.
- *Template text a page hides from every visitor is no longer reported as unfinished.* Page builders can leave unused
  template blocks ("Lorem ipsum", "Heading 2 text goes here") in a page and switch them off in the page's own
  stylesheet. Nobody sees them, but they were reported as unfinished content at high severity. Text hidden with
  the hidden attribute, an inline style or the page's own unconditional display:none is now left out. The same
  words where a visitor can see them, including a block shown only on phones, are still reported.

99 checks across 13 areas.
